results.name: Brad Pitt's Next Movie After F1 Is A War Film Reunion 11 Years In The Making
results.content:
Brad Pitt is one of the most successful actors currently working in Hollywood, with a massive number of extremely well-liked projects under his belt. However, one of his most interesting upcoming movies is *Heart of the Beast*, which will see Pitt reunited with someone he hasn't directly worked with in over 11 years.  
Recently, the actor found success with [the well-reviewed racing movie *F1*](http://screenrant.com/f1-the-movie-review/) and has become a decent hit at the box office despite some heavy competition. A few of his more recent movies haven't done all that well, but **the actor is still a big draw who can clearly bring in audiences**.
## Brad Pitt Is Reuniting With Fury Director David Ayer For Heart Of The Beast  
### This New Film Marks Their First Collaboration Since 2014  
*Heart of the Beast* is an upcoming action/adventure film that centers around a Navy SEAL, played by Pitt, who gets lost in the Alaskan wilderness and has to find his way back to civilization, accompanied only by his retired combat dog.  
The film is being [directed by David Ayer](https://screenrant.com/david-ayer-movies-ranked-worst-best/), who is most notable for the plethora of action films he has created, including *Training Day*, *The Fast and the Furious*, 2016's *Suicide Squad*, and a couple of recent Jason Statham projects, such as *The Beekeeper* and *A Working Man*.  
Ayer was also behind the writing of *Fury*, while *Heart of the Beast* is being written by Cameron Alexander, who doesn't have too many credits to his name yet.  
Most notably for *Heart of the Beast*, however, [Ayer also directed *Fury*](https://screenrant.com/fury-war-movie-brad-pitt-streaming-netflix-underrated/), a war movie that starred Pitt as the commander of an American tank fighting in Nazi Germany during World War II. **That movie was a pretty solid hit**, earning good reviews and making over $200 million at the box office on a budget of around $80 million.
##### [Brad Pitt Is An Underappreciated Summer Blockbuster King](https://screenrant.com/f1-movie-brad-pitt-box-office-june-blockbusters/)  
F1 The Movie has already become one of the most successful films of Brad Pitt's career, proving that he can still dominate the box office.  
Since this is [Pitt and Ayer's first collaboration since *Fury*](https://screenrant.com/heart-of-the-beast-movie-filming-update-david-ayer/), **the hope is that the duo will be able to make something that manages to be on par** with that movie. Ayer was also behind the writing of *Fury*, while *Heart of the Beast* is being written by Cameron Alexander, who doesn't have too many credits to his name yet.

## [Brad Pitt Stars as Brad Pitt in New Brad Pitt Movie](http://www.annehelenpetersen.com/p-2733)  
Writing about Brad Pitt is too easy. He’s the quintessential movie star. He’s the type of star that fits so neatly into Richard Dyer’s conception of stars as images both extraordinary and ordinary that embody and reconcile ideologies. That’s a complex way of saying that Brad Pitt plays the societal function that classic stars did: his image is of a particular type of masculinity, and that masculinity mirrors what the dominant American society values/tolerates/expects/valorizes in a man in terms of looks and attitudes towards women, parenting, multiculturalism, philanthropy, or marriage.  
When we say “Brad Pitt is the ideal man,” what we are actually saying is that he embodies what our current society thinks is ideal. Brad Pitt didn’t make those things ideal; he became popular because his image matched the things that our society values.
I saw *Moneyball* this weekend. It was fine. There was something off about the pacing. But I’d go see it again, if only because I love watching Brad Pitt play Brad Pitt. It looks effortless, which actually means it’s probably pretty hard. But because it seems so easy — because the charisma seems authentic, because it looks like he’s just walking out his real life and onto the screen — it makes it all the more appealing. Someone who goes through life with that *ease* exists. Or at least that’s the promise that “playing oneself” makes. It’s a beautiful illusion to watch — and it’s the reason the film, no matter its merits, will make money, and why Pitt receives the paychecks he does. *Moneyball* may not have beat *The Lion King* in 3D, but few things get infrequent movie-goers to the theaters like a real movie star acting as such onscreen. I could watch it all day. And so could you.

## Brad Pitt News: Actor’s New Movie *Wolfs*Premieres  
Brad Pitt has returned to the big screen with pal [George Clooney](https://www.biography.com/actors/george-clooney) in the action-comedy *Wolfs*. The 60-year-old Pitt [portrays](https://variety.com/2024/film/news/wolfs-george-clooney-brad-pitt-wolfs-sequel-apple-release-limited-1236099549/) Nick, a professional fixer, who is forced to work with his rival in covering up a high-profile crime despite both men preferring to act alone.  
*Wolfs* first premiered at the 2024 Venice Film Festival, where it received a 5-minute ovation. After a week-long run in select theaters September 20, the movie began [streaming on Apple TV+](https://go.redirectingat.com?id=74968X1712615&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftv.apple.com%2Fus%2Fmovie%2Fwolfs%2Fumc.cmc.c3xhu25rw4jxxxzq4oio6snu) September 27.  
*Wolfs* marks the first time Pitt has shared the screen with Clooney in 16 years, with the pair last working together in the 2008 movie *Burn After Reading*. Pitt [told *Deadline*](https://deadline.com/2024/09/wolfs-5-minute-ovation-george-clooney-brad-pitt-venice-film-festival-1236075206/) the new movie was the perfect project for the two actors to reunite.
## Who Is Brad Pitt?  
Academy Award–winning actor Brad Pitt is one of the most recognizable stars in Hollywood since his rise in the 1990s. His major movie roles have included *Ocean’s Eleven*, *Troy*, *Mr. and Mrs. Smith*, *The Curious Case of Benjamin Button*, *Moneyball*, and *Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood*, for which he won an Oscar. Initially cast in many pretty boy roles, Pitt first proved his willingness to take on grittier roles in the 1999 cult classic *Fight Club* and began earning more serious award consideration following his 2006 performance in *Babel*. The Midwest native has also proved to be a successful movie producer, backing the Oscar-winning *12 Years a Slave* among many others. Pitt is also known for his high-profile marriages with fellow actors [Jennifer Aniston](https://www.biography.com/actors/jennifer-aniston) and [Angelina Jolie](https://www.biography.com/actors/angelina-jolie). His current girlfriend is fashion executive Ines de Ramon.
## Net Worth  
As of August 2024, Pitt has an estimated net worth of $400 million, according to [Celebrity Net Worth](https://www.celebritynetworth.com/richest-celebrities/actors/brad-pitt-net-worth/). He earns a minimum of $20 million per movie, making him one of the highest-paid actors in Hollywood. His largest upfront salary was for his new movie *Wolfs*; he was paid $35 million.  
In addition to acting, Pitt co-founded a production company in 2001 with his then-wife [Jennifer Aniston](https://www.biography.com/actors/jennifer-aniston) and then-manager Brad Grey. Plan B Entertainment has produced many successful and award-winning movies such as *The Departed* (2006), *12 Years a Slave* (2013), *Women Talking* (2022), and *Wolfs* (2024). Pitt assumed sole ownership of Plan B in 2005 following his and Aniston’s divorce and sold a major stake in the company in 2022. The deal was [reportedly worth](https://www.cnbc.com/2022/12/09/brad-pitt-sells-majority-of-plan-b-to-mediawan.html) hundreds of millions of dollars but less than $500 million.
